# Hertel Ski Wax

> > Premium ski and snowboard wax manufacturer founded by Terry Hertel in 1972, pioneering all-temperature wax technology and surfactant chemistry for Olympic-level performance.

Hertel invented the first all-temperature ski wax in 1973 and introduced fluorocarbon wax technology in 1986. Based in Northern California near Lake Tahoe, the company produces the Amazon bestselling Super HotSauce wax along with specialized formulas like Racing 739 and SpringSolution, all made in the USA.
